findingDetails.title: SCG-004 grades the documented cut order with a five-step numbering that skips canonical step 3 and renumbers 4-6 as 3-5
findingDetails.evidence: scenario: 'apply cut-order step 3 only: remove the parent text that restates the child goal' (command 11, :60) vs budget-and-handoff.md:43 '3. Remove author instructions an older template left above the log: a blockquote under the title, an `Operator copy` section and a criteria introduction.' and :44 '4. Remove parent text that restates a child's goal.'
findingDetails.impact: The step number is the scenario's grading key (commands 11/13/15 and the N0,N0,N1,N2 Expected row), so a canonical-order run is misgraded label by label, and a scenario-order run never executes the canonical step 3 removal of legacy author instructions while still reporting PASS.
findingDetails.fix: Renumber commands 11/13/15 to canonical steps 4/5/6 and insert 'apply cut-order step 3 only: remove any legacy author instructions above the log (a no-op for this fixture)' before them; adjust the Expected row to the seven-step transcript.

findingDetails.title: SCG-005 seeds goal.md.tmpl placeholder bytes a /create:goal run cannot produce; the mode authors from the asset templates
findingDetails.evidence: scenario:83 'The decision row that step 5 seeds is the goal template's own placeholder text:' + '| D1 | [The decision, stated so a reader can tell whether work honors it] |' (= goal.md.tmpl:48); but create-goal-presentation.txt:90 names the asset templates and goal-top-level-template.md:80 words the row '| D1 | [A frozen choice from spec.md or decision-record.md, stated so a reader can tell whether work honors it] |'.
findingDetails.impact: The seeded bytes come from a template the graded operation never copies, so the scenario's seeded-versus-reported comparison references text no run produces; the check stays robust because check-goal.cjs:264-286 merges all asset placeholder wordings, so this is a provenance defect, not a checker gap.
findingDetails.fix: Seed the top-level asset wording '| D1 | [A frozen choice from spec.md or decision-record.md, stated so a reader can tell whether work honors it] |' and re-point the anchor to assets/goal-top-level-template.md, or state any merged placeholder wording seeds the same finding.

findingDetails.title: Goal hooks README names the bind-time projection 'operator copy' while the mode reserves `Operator copy` for legacy text to delete and calls the projection `objective_slice`
findingDetails.evidence: README:65 'derives the operator copy (the pointer first, the binding sentence when the packet is phased, then the completion criteria copied out)' and :32 'an operator copy derived from the file'; budget-and-handoff.md:66-70 names the same projection `objective_slice` ('never pasted in chat'), :43 and :68 reserve `Operator copy` for the legacy section cut-order step 3 removes. The README points at no canonical home.
findingDetails.impact: One term means a live projection in the hooks docs and deletable legacy text in the mode's rules; an operator cutting a parent per section 3 step 3 who greps 'Operator copy' lands on the hooks README and finds something the mode actively maintains. This is a rule restatement that does not point to the canonical home.
findingDetails.fix: Rename to 'the objective slice (`objective_slice`)' at README:32 and :65 and add a pointer: 'what a parent goal sent in chat contains is sk-create-goal's references/budget-and-handoff.md section 4.'
